about: Country cards for lives born in Nigeria. Each card is dealt only to them (and a little more often than general cards). Sources are in each card's "src".

events.src: ===================== Nigeria (NG) ===================== NYSC: a year of service after university; the allowance rose from ₦33,000 to ₦77,000 a month, approved in Sep 2024 (ThisDay, 26 Sep 2024; ICIR). ₦924,000 a year ÷ a full year at the 2024 minimum wage (₦840,000) ≈ 1.1.

ns.do: nsUntil = age + 1; nsPay = 1.1; nsCost = c; T('ns', { kind: 'custom', label: M('trk.nysc'), paid: 0, note: M('note.ns', { a: MN(0) }) })

opts.do: ns(.65); addSkill('saed', 2, M('trk.saed')); later(age + 1, 'sideBiz', { id: 'ng_saed', p: .35, a: .12 * base, n: 5 })

en..x: After university comes a year of National Youth Service Corps (NYSC). Corps members are posted to another state and paid ₦77,000 a month (since 2024).
en..serve.s: A year far from home, and new friends.
en..saed: Serve, and learn a trade too
en..saed.h: Skill +2, and maybe a small business on the side later.
en..home: Ask to be posted near your family

zh..x: 大学毕业后要参加一年全国青年服务队（NYSC）。队员会被派到别的州，每月津贴77,000奈拉（2024年起）。
zh..saed.h: 技能 +2，以后也许能做点小生意。

zht..x: 大學畢業後要參加一年全國青年服務隊（NYSC）。隊員會被派到別的州，每月津貼77,000奈拉（2024年起）。
zht..saed.h: 技能 +2，以後也許能做點小生意。

events.src: Japa: UK Skilled Worker visa £719 (up to 3 years, from Oct 2023) and the Immigration Health Surcharge £1,035 a year (Mayer Brown; Edwin Coe). With flights and a deposit, about £6,000, at market exchange rates ≈ 6 years of a Nigerian typical wage (ESTIMATE). Pay and costs in the UK are ESTIMATES from the two countries' typical wages.

opts.ok: liquid() >= f || M('e.home.need', { n: MN(f), h: MN(liquid()) })
opts.do: pay(f); abroad = gi; costMul = 5; happy -= 4; rl(-5); bump('abroad', 6, M('trk.abroad', { c: { k: '_c', ci: gi } })); trk.abroad.v -= f

en..x: Many young Nigerians are moving abroad (“japa”). A UK employer offers to sponsor you for a Skilled Worker visa. The visa fee was £719 for up to three years and the Immigration Health Surcharge is £1,035 a year; then come flights and a deposit on a flat.
en..go.s: Pay of about {a} a year, but living costs about five times higher. Visa, health surcharge, flights and a deposit: about {f}. Far from family: Happiness −4.
en..stay.s: Your life stays as it is.

zh..x: 很多尼日利亚年轻人移居海外（“japa”）。一位英国雇主愿意担保你申请技术工作签证。三年内的签证费是£719，移民健康附加费每年£1,035，还有机票和租房押金。
zh..go.s: 年薪约{a}，但生活费约高五倍。签证、健康附加费、机票和押金约{f}。远离家人：幸福感 −4。

zht..x: 很多奈及利亞年輕人移居海外（「japa」）。一位英國僱主願意擔保你申請技術工作簽證。三年內的簽證費是£719，移民健康附加費每年£1,035，還有機票和租房押金。
zht..go.s: 年薪約{a}，但生活費約高五倍。簽證、健康附加費、機票和押金約{f}。遠離家人：幸福感 −4。

events.src: Inflation: 34.80% in December 2024, after the May 2023 subsidy removal and naira devaluation (NBS, via TechCabal and Intelpoint); rebased CPI showed 24.48% in January 2025. Savings rates far below that: a 12–25% real loss in a year is an ESTIMATE.

en..x: Inflation reached 34.8% in December 2024, after the naira was devalued and the fuel subsidy ended in 2023. Savings accounts pay far less, so money left in naira loses value.

zh..x: 奈拉在2023年贬值、燃油补贴取消后，通胀率在2024年12月达到34.8%。储蓄账户的利息低得多，存在奈拉里的钱会缩水。

zht..x: 奈拉在2023年貶值、燃油補貼取消後，通膨率在2024年12月達到34.8%。儲蓄帳戶的利息低得多，存在奈拉里的錢會縮水。

events.src: Generators and solar: Nigerians spend over $14bn a year on generator fuel (Stears/Sterling, via ThisDay, 2023); home solar installations cost about ₦1.5–3.5 million (BusinessDay); 1.25% of households had solar in 2022 (BCG/All On, via AP). A small system ≈ 1.8 years of the minimum wage; fuel and upkeep are ESTIMATES.

opts.do: T('ng_gen', { kind: 'custom', label: M('trk.ng_gen') }); rec('ng_gen', .25 * B, 12, -.2)
const t = T('ng_gen', { kind: 'custom', label: M('trk.ng_solar') }); pay(1.8 * B); t.v -= 1.8 * B; rec('ng_gen', .03 * B, 12); happy += 2

en..x: Mains power comes only part of the day, so many homes run petrol generators, and petrol prices multiplied after the fuel subsidy ended in May 2023. A home solar system with batteries costs about ₦1.5–3.5 million up front but needs no fuel.
en..gen.s: About {a} a year in fuel and repairs.
en..gen.h: The fumes cost a little Health each year.
en..solar.s: About {a} now, then about {b} a year for upkeep. Happiness +2.
en..none.s: Rechargeable fans and lamps when the power is off. Happiness −3.

zh..x: 公共电网一天只供电一段时间，所以很多家庭用汽油发电机；2023年5月燃油补贴取消后，汽油价格翻了好几倍。一套带电池的家用太阳能系统前期约150万到350万奈拉，但不用燃料。
zh..gen.h: 废气每年会消耗一点健康。
zh..solar.s: 现在约{a}，之后每年维护约{b}。幸福感 +2。
zh..none.s: 停电时用充电风扇和灯。幸福感 −3。

zht..x: 公共電網一天只供電一段時間，所以很多家庭用汽油發電機；2023年5月燃油補貼取消後，汽油價格翻了好幾倍。一套帶電池的家用太陽能系統前期約150萬到350萬奈拉，但不用燃料。
zht..gen.h: 廢氣每年會消耗一點健康。
zht..solar.s: 現在約{a}，之後每年維護約{b}。幸福感 +2。
zht..none.s: 停電時用充電風扇和燈。幸福感 −3。

events.src: Floods: the 2022 floods killed 662 people and displaced 2.4 million (NEMA, via Channels TV and Daily Trust, Jan 2023). The chance that a flood or storm reaches you comes from EM-DAT (people affected a year, 2000–2024: js/data.js); premiums, damage and preparation costs are ESTIMATES.

en..x: In 2022 Nigeria had its worst floods in a decade: 662 people died and about 2.4 million were displaced. Your area is low-lying and floods in heavy rainy seasons.

zh..x: 2022年尼日利亚遭遇十年来最严重的水灾：662人死亡，约240万人流离失所。你住的地方地势低，雨季大雨时会淹水。

zht..x: 2022年奈及利亞遭遇十年來最嚴重的水災：662人死亡，約240萬人流離失所。你住的地方地勢低，雨季大雨時會淹水。

events.src: Ajo / esusu: a rotating savings group run by a collector; a widespread Nigerian practice. Fees and risk are ESTIMATES.

en..x: Traders on your street run an ajo (esusu): everyone pays a fixed amount to a collector, and members take the whole pot in turn. The collector keeps a small fee.

zh..x: 你那条街的商贩办了一个互助会（ajo，也叫esusu）：大家定期交固定金额给收款人，会员轮流拿走全部会钱。收款人会收一点手续费。

zht..x: 你那條街的商販辦了一個互助會（ajo，也叫esusu）：大家定期交固定金額給收款人，會員輪流拿走全部會錢。收款人會收一點手續費。

events.src: Health insurance: the National Health Insurance Authority Act 2022 made health insurance compulsory and set up state schemes for informal workers (NHIA). Premiums and cover share are ESTIMATES.

en..x: The National Health Insurance Authority Act of 2022 made health insurance compulsory for everyone, and states run schemes that informal workers can join for a yearly premium.
en..join.h: It pays about half of your medical bills.

zh..x: 2022年《国家健康保险局法》规定人人都要有医疗保险，各州为非正规就业者办了缴年费就能参加的保险计划。

zht..x: 2022年《國家健康保險局法》規定人人都要有醫療保險，各州為非正規就業者辦了繳年費就能參加的保險計畫。

events.src: Micro Pension Plan: PenCom's plan for the self-employed and informal workers (launched 2019), with contingent withdrawals (TheCable 2024; ThisDay 2019). Pension funds' real returns near 0% in high-inflation years: an ESTIMATE.

opts.do: yearly('mpp', { amt: a, until: 60 }, { rate: 0, lock: 60 }, 'trk.mpp')

en..x: Self-employed people can join PenCom’s Micro Pension Plan (since 2019): you choose how much to pay in, and part of it can be taken out in an emergency.

zh..x: 自雇人士可以参加养老金委员会（PenCom）的微型养老金计划（2019年起）：自己决定存多少，紧急时可以提出一部分。

zht..x: 自僱人士可以參加退休金委員會（PenCom）的微型退休金計畫（2019年起）：自己決定存多少，緊急時可以提出一部分。

events.src: Ponzi schemes: CBEX, a “crypto trading” app promising high monthly returns, collapsed on 14 April 2025; about 600,000 Nigerians reportedly lost over ₦1 trillion (Arise TV; Nairametrics); the SEC said it was never registered, and when it reappeared in June 2025 it demanded “withdrawal fees” (SEC warning, via Nairametrics). MMM Nigeria froze accounts in December 2016. Amounts are compared with a year at the national minimum wage, ₦70,000 a month (₦840,000) from 2024 (Minimum Wage Act 2024). Amounts and odds are an ESTIMATE.

en..t: A trading app that pays every week
en..x: Your church friend shows you her trading app: it uses “AI” to trade crypto and has paid her every week for months. Bring two friends and you earn a bonus.
en..in.h: Schemes that pay early investors from new money always collapse.
en..no.s: It sounds too good to be true.
en..no.h: It isn’t registered with the SEC.

zh..x: 教会的朋友给你看她的交易App：说是用“人工智能”炒加密货币，几个月来每周都有入账。拉两个朋友加入还有奖金。
zh..in.h: 用新钱付老会员的模式迟早会垮。

zht..x: 教會的朋友給你看她的交易App：說是用「人工智慧」炒加密貨幣，幾個月來每週都有入帳。拉兩個朋友加入還有獎金。
zht..in.h: 用新錢付老會員的模式遲早會垮。

events.src: After collapsing, CBEX asked users for “withdrawal fees” to release their money (SEC warning, Jun 2025). The fee is an ESTIMATE.

en..x: The app has stopped paying and your balance of {a} shows zero. A message says you can get it back by paying a “release fee” first.
en..walk: Report it to the EFCC and walk away
en..fee.h: Happiness −4. The fee is part of the scam.

zh..x: App停止付款，你那{a}的余额显示为零。有讯息说先付一笔“解冻费”就能拿回来。
zh..walk: 向经济犯罪委员会检举，认了
zh..fee.h: 幸福感 −4。解冻费也是骗局的一部分。

zht..x: App停止付款，你那{a}的餘額顯示為零。有訊息說先付一筆「解凍費」就能拿回來。
zht..walk: 向經濟犯罪委員會檢舉，認了
zht..fee.h: 幸福感 −4。解凍費也是騙局的一部分。

events.src: Buying land in Lagos: fake documents are common, and buyers are advised to check the survey plan and title (C of O, deed, Governor’s Consent) at the Lands Bureau and the Surveyor-General; consent and registration cost about 3% of the value since 2015, and some “omo-onile” (families of the original owners) demand extra payments (The Guardian Nigeria; Ripples Nigeria; Gazette, 2025). Amounts are compared with a year at the national minimum wage, ₦70,000 a month (₦840,000) from 2024 (Minimum Wage Act 2024). Costs and odds are an ESTIMATE.

en..x: An agent is selling plots in a new estate on the Lekki-Epe road. “Prices go up every month,” he says. A lawyer friend says to check the papers first.
en..check: Buy, after a lawyer and surveyor check the title
en..check.s: {a}, plus about {b} for the checks and the consent fee.
en..check.h: Land near growing roads rises faster than inflation; the checks make the title safe.
en..quick: Buy now, before the price goes up
en..quick.h: Skipping the checks risks fake papers or a land dispute.

zh..x: 有个中介在卖莱基—埃佩公路旁新社区的地。他说：“每个月都在涨。”当律师的朋友说先查清文件再说。
zh..check: 先请律师和测量师查产权，再买
zh..check.h: 新路附近的地涨得比通胀快；查过的产权比较安全。
zh..quick.h: 跳过查证，可能遇到假文件或土地纠纷。

zht..x: 有個仲介在賣萊基—埃佩公路旁新社區的地。他說：「每個月都在漲。」當律師的朋友說先查清文件再說。
zht..check: 先請律師和測量師查產權，再買
zht..check.h: 新路附近的地漲得比通膨快；查過的產權比較安全。
zht..quick.h: 跳過查證，可能遇到假文件或土地糾紛。

events.src: Disputes over land sold twice or with false papers often end in court or in payments to the omo-onile (Lagos Lands Bureau officials, via Gazette). Sizes are an ESTIMATE.

en..t: Someone else is building on your plot
en..x: You visit your plot and find a foundation going up. A family says the land is theirs and the agent had no right to sell it.
en..court.s: About {a} in legal fees, and years of hearings.
en..court.h: Happiness −3. About half keep their land.
en.trk.ng_court: Legal fees for a land dispute

zh..t: 有人在你的地上盖房子
zh..x: 你去看你的地，发现有人在打地基。一家人说那块地是他们的，中介根本无权卖。
zh..court.s: 律师费大约{a}，还要开好几年庭。
zh..court.h: 幸福感 −3。大约一半能保住土地。

zht..t: 有人在你的地上蓋房子
zht..x: 你去看你的地，發現有人在打地基。一家人說那塊地是他們的，仲介根本無權賣。
zht..court.s: 律師費大約{a}，還要開好幾年庭。
zht..court.h: 幸福感 −3。大約一半能保住土地。

events.src: University: federal universities charge low fees but strikes are common (ASUU struck from 14 February to 14 October 2022, eight months; ThisDay). NELFUND student loans (Student Loans Act 2024) pay fees and upkeep at public institutions, interest-free, repaid at 10% of pay once you work after NYSC; over 864,000 students had received loans (NELFUND, via Arise TV). Private university fees (about ₦2 million a year, ≈ 9.5 of the game’s yardstick for four years) and the pay effects are an ESTIMATE. Amounts are compared with a year at the national minimum wage, ₦70,000 a month (₦840,000) from 2024 (Minimum Wage Act 2024).

later.ng_nel: const t = T('ng_nel', {kind: 'custom', label: M('trk.ng_nel')}); rec('ng_nel', .1 * base, 5)

en..x: You have a place at a federal university. Some classmates are going to private universities instead, where lecturers don’t go on strike.
en..fed.s: Low fees, paid by your family.
en..fed.h: A strike may cost you months.
en..loan: The federal university, with a NELFUND loan
en..loan.s: Fees and upkeep covered, about {a} in all; repaid from your pay later.
en..loan.h: No interest; 10% of your pay goes to repayments for some years once you work.
en..private.s: About {a} for four years, paid by your family.{b}
en..private.h: Happiness +2, no strikes; pay about 2% higher.

zh..t: 联邦大学还是私立大学？
zh..x: 你考上了一所联邦大学。有些同学改去念私立大学，那里的讲师不会罢工。
zh..fed.h: 罢工可能让你耽误好几个月。
zh..loan.s: 学费和生活费都有，总共大约{a}；以后从薪水扣还。
zh..loan.h: 零利息；工作后有几年要拿薪水的10%来还。
zh..private.h: 幸福感 +2，不会罢工；薪水大约高2%。

zht..t: 聯邦大學還是私立大學？
zht..x: 你考上了一所聯邦大學。有些同學改去念私立大學，那裡的講師不會罷工。
zht..fed.h: 罷工可能讓你耽誤好幾個月。
zht..loan.s: 學費和生活費都有，總共大約{a}；以後從薪水扣還。
zht..loan.h: 零利息；工作後有幾年要拿薪水的10%來還。
zht..private.h: 幸福感 +2，不會罷工；薪水大約高2%。

events.src: Weddings: traditional and church weddings with hundreds of guests in matching aso-ebi fabric are common, and guests bring gifts and cash; “spraying” naira notes at parties is an offence under Section 21 of the CBN Act (at least six months or a ₦50,000 fine), and the EFCC has prosecuted celebrities for it since 2024 (TheCable; Gazette, Oct 2026). Amounts are compared with a year at the national minimum wage, ₦70,000 a month (₦840,000) from 2024 (Minimum Wage Act 2024). Costs and gifts are an ESTIMATE.

opts.do: pay(3 * base); cash += 1.2 * base; const tq = T('ng_wed', {kind: 'custom', label: M('trk.ng_wed')}); tq.v += -1.8 * base; happy += 3
pay(1.2 * base); cash += .5 * base; const tq = T('ng_wed', {kind: 'custom', label: M('trk.ng_wed')}); tq.v += -.7 * base; happy += 1
pay(.2 * base); const tq = T('ng_wed', {kind: 'custom', label: M('trk.ng_wed')}); tq.v += -.2 * base

en..x: You and your partner are getting married. Your mother has already chosen the aso-ebi fabric for 400 guests, and the families expect a traditional wedding and a church one.
en..big.s: About {a}; guests’ gifts pay some of it back.
en..big.h: Happiness +3; the families are proud. Gifts cover about 40%.
en..mid: A smaller church wedding and reception
en..mid.s: About {a}; gifts pay some of it back.
en..registry: The registry and a family lunch

zh..x: 你和伴侣要结婚了。你妈已经帮四百位宾客挑好了统一的布料，两家人都期待办传统婚礼加教堂婚礼。
zh..big.s: 大约{a}；宾客的礼金能收回一部分。
zh..big.h: 幸福感 +3；两家都很有面子。礼金大约能抵四成。
zh..mid: 小一点的教堂婚礼和喜宴
zh..mid.s: 大约{a}；礼金能收回一部分。
zh.trk.ng_wed: 扣掉礼金后的婚礼开销

zht..x: 你和伴侶要結婚了。你媽已經幫四百位賓客挑好了統一的布料，兩家人都期待辦傳統婚禮加教堂婚禮。
zht..big.s: 大約{a}；賓客的禮金能收回一部分。
zht..big.h: 幸福感 +3；兩家都很有面子。禮金大約能抵四成。
zht..mid: 小一點的教堂婚禮和喜宴
zht..mid.s: 大約{a}；禮金能收回一部分。
zht.trk.ng_wed: 扣掉禮金後的婚禮開銷

events.src: The naira fell from about ₦465 a dollar in mid-2023 to ₦907 at the end of 2023 and ₦1,535 at the end of 2024 (CBN, via Nairametrics and BusinessDay); many savers moved money into domiciliary (dollar) accounts, which the CBN said it had no plan to convert (Africa Check, 2024). Amounts are compared with a year at the national minimum wage, ₦70,000 a month (₦840,000) from 2024 (Minimum Wage Act 2024). Real returns are an ESTIMATE.

en..x: The naira has lost two-thirds of its value against the dollar in two years. Your bank offers a domiciliary account in dollars, or a naira fixed deposit at 20%.
en..dom.h: Holds its value much better than naira.
en..fixed.h: 20% sounds high, but prices rise faster.
en..keep.h: Cash loses the most to inflation.

zh..x: 奈拉两年内对美元贬值了三分之二。银行可以帮你开美元户头，或做年利20%的奈拉定存。
zh..fixed.h: 20%听起来很高，但物价涨得更快。
zh..keep.h: 现金被通胀吃掉的最多。

zht..x: 奈拉兩年內對美元貶值了三分之二。銀行可以幫你開美元帳戶，或做年利20%的奈拉定存。
zht..fixed.h: 20%聽起來很高，但物價漲得更快。
zht..keep.h: 現金被通膨吃掉的最多。

events.src: POS agents: Nigeria had about 5.9 million active POS terminals, and POS payments reached ₦18 trillion in 2024 (TechCabal; NIBSS data); agents earn a fee on each withdrawal or transfer (₦100–150 per ₦5,000 in Lagos), and from December 2024 the CBN limited agents to ₦1.2 million cash out a day (TechCabal). Amounts are compared with a year at the national minimum wage, ₦70,000 a month (₦840,000) from 2024 (Minimum Wage Act 2024). Start-up costs, earnings and fraud odds are an ESTIMATE.

opts.do: pay(.5 * base); const tq = T('ng_pos', {kind: 'custom', label: M('trk.ng_pos')}); tq.v -= .5 * base; rec('ng_pos', -.3 * base, 8, -.2); happy -= 1

en..x: There’s no bank for kilometres around your street, and people queue at the one POS stand. A fintech will give you a terminal if you keep a float.
en..start.s: About {a} for the float, a kiosk and an umbrella.
en..start.h: A steady fee income; long hours in the sun, and fraud is a risk.

zh..x: 你家这条街几公里内都没有银行，大家都在唯一一个POS摊前排队。一家金融科技公司说只要你备好周转金，就给你一台刷卡机。
zh..start.s: 周转金、小亭子和遮阳伞大约{a}。
zh..start.h: 有稳定的手续费收入；但要长时间晒太阳，还有被骗的风险。

zht..x: 你家這條街幾公里內都沒有銀行，大家都在唯一一個POS攤前排隊。一家金融科技公司說只要你備好周轉金，就給你一台刷卡機。
zht..start.s: 周轉金、小亭子和遮陽傘大約{a}。
zht..start.h: 有穩定的手續費收入；但要長時間曬太陽，還有被騙的風險。

events.src: Fake transfer alerts and robberies are common risks for POS agents (TechCabal; news reports). Amounts are an ESTIMATE.

en..x: A customer showed you a transfer alert on his phone and left with the cash. The money never arrived.
en..absorb: Take the loss and keep going
en..absorb.h: Happiness −2; you check every alert from now on.
en..close: Take the loss and close the stand

zh..x: 有个客人拿手机上的转账通知给你看，拿了现金就走了。钱根本没到账。
zh..absorb.h: 幸福感 −2；以后每笔都仔细确认。

zht..x: 有個客人拿手機上的轉帳通知給你看，拿了現金就走了。錢根本沒到帳。
zht..absorb.h: 幸福感 −2；以後每筆都仔細確認。

events.src: CNG: after the fuel subsidy ended in 2023, petrol rose to about ₦1,265 a litre in Lagos (NNPC, Aug 2026, via Legit) while CNG sold at about ₦230; conversion kits cost about ₦1–1.5 million, free for many commercial vehicles under the Presidential CNG Initiative (P-CNGi, via ThisDay and The Guardian). ₦1.2 million ≈ 1.4 of the game’s yardstick. Amounts are compared with a year at the national minimum wage, ₦70,000 a month (₦840,000) from 2024 (Minimum Wage Act 2024). Savings depend on driving: an ESTIMATE.

opts.do: spend('ng_cng', 1.4 * base, 'trk.ng_cng'); T('ng_cngS', {kind: 'custom', label: M('trk.ng_cngS')}); rec('ng_cngS', -.3 * base, 8)

en..x: Petrol now costs five times what CNG does. A workshop can convert your car to run on gas.
en..convert.s: About {a} for the kit and fitting.
en..convert.h: Much cheaper to run, though CNG stations are still few.
en..keep.h: Fuel stays your biggest running cost.

zh..x: 汽油现在是压缩天然气的五倍价钱。修车厂可以把你的车改成烧天然气。
zh..convert.h: 用车成本低很多，但加气站还很少。
zh..keep.h: 油钱还是最大的用车开销。
zh.trk.ng_cngS: 改用天然气省下的油钱

zht..x: 汽油現在是壓縮天然氣的五倍價錢。修車廠可以把你的車改成燒天然氣。
zht..convert.h: 用車成本低很多，但加氣站還很少。
zht..keep.h: 油錢還是最大的用車開銷。
zht.trk.ng_cngS: 改用天然氣省下的油錢

events.src: Rent in Lagos: the Lagos Tenancy Law 2011 makes it unlawful to demand more than a year’s rent in advance from a new tenant (BusinessDay), but landlords commonly ask for one to two years plus agency and legal fees of about 10% each (Ownkey, 2026). Amounts are compared with a year at the national minimum wage, ₦70,000 a month (₦840,000) from 2024 (Minimum Wage Act 2024). Amounts are an ESTIMATE.

opts.do: if (roll('ng_rent') < .5) spend('ng_fees', .12 * base, 'trk.ng_fees'); else { T('ng_far', {kind: 'custom', label: M('trk.ng_far')}); rec('ng_far', -.05 * base, 4, -.3); happy -= 2 }
T('ng_far', {kind: 'custom', label: M('trk.ng_far')}); rec('ng_far', -.05 * base, 4, -.3); happy -= 2

en..x: You’ve found a flat on the mainland. The landlord wants two years’ rent upfront, plus agency and legal fees.
en..pay.s: About {a} in fees on top of the rent.
en..pay.h: Happiness +1: a good flat near work.
en..law: Offer one year, as the law allows
en..law.s: The law is on your side; the landlord may not be.
en..law.h: Half of landlords agree; the others let it to someone else.
en..far.h: Rent saved, but Happiness −2 and Health a little lower each year.

zh..x: 你在本岛那边找到一间公寓。房东要预付两年房租，另外还有中介费和律师费。
zh..pay.s: 房租之外另付大约{a}的费用。
zh..pay.h: 幸福感 +1：离公司近的好房子。
zh..law.s: 法律站在你这边，房东不一定。
zh..law.h: 一半的房东会答应；其他的就租给别人。
zh..far.h: 省了房租，但幸福感 −2，健康每年少一点。

zht..x: 你在本島那邊找到一間公寓。房東要預付兩年房租，另外還有仲介費和律師費。
zht..pay.s: 房租之外另付大約{a}的費用。
zht..pay.h: 幸福感 +1：離公司近的好房子。
zht..law.s: 法律站在你這邊，房東不一定。
zht..law.h: 一半的房東會答應；其他的就租給別人。
zht..far.h: 省了房租，但幸福感 −2，健康每年少一點。

events.src: Sports betting: about 60 million Nigerians aged 18–40 were involved in sports betting, and over half of them bet daily (NOIPolls, 2019). Bookmakers keep a margin on every bet, so bettors lose over time. Amounts are compared with a year at the national minimum wage, ₦70,000 a month (₦840,000) from 2024 (Minimum Wage Act 2024). Odds and amounts are an ESTIMATE.

en..x: Everyone at work is on a betting app before the weekend’s matches. A colleague says his ten-game accumulator is “sure banker”.
en..bet.h: The bookmaker keeps a cut of every bet; bettors lose over time.

zh..x: 周末比赛前，同事全都在用投注App。有个同事说他的十场串关“稳赢”。
zh..bet.h: 庄家每一注都抽成；赌的人迟早会输。

zht..x: 週末比賽前，同事全都在用投注App。有個同事說他的十場過關「穩贏」。
zht..bet.h: 莊家每一注都抽成；賭的人遲早會輸。

events.src: ESTIMATE: game rule (bettors who chase losses usually lose more; some borrow to bet, BusinessDay 2024).

en..x: Your last ticket lost by one match. The app offers a bonus if you deposit again today.
en..more: Deposit again and win it back
en..more.h: Happiness −3. Chasing losses almost always ends in bigger losses.
en..stop.s: Tell a friend to keep you honest.

zh..x: 你上一张彩票只差一场就中了。App说今天再储值就送奖金。
zh..more.h: 幸福感 −3。追输的钱几乎都会输得更多。

zht..x: 你上一張彩票只差一場就中了。App說今天再儲值就送獎金。
zht..more.h: 幸福感 −3。追輸的錢幾乎都會輸得更多。

events.src: Remote work: Nigerian professionals increasingly work remotely for foreign firms, paid in dollars through platforms such as Deel; after the 2023–24 devaluation, dollar pay is worth several times local pay. Pay multiples, contract length and the risk of the contract ending are an ESTIMATE. Amounts are compared with a year at the national minimum wage, ₦70,000 a month (₦840,000) from 2024 (Minimum Wage Act 2024).

en..t: A remote job paid in dollars
en..x: A London start-up offers you a remote contract paid in dollars, working UK hours from your flat in Lagos.
en..take.s: Paid in dollars; you need your own power and internet.
en..take.h: Pay about 80% higher while it lasts, but contracts end easily. Health a little lower from long days.

zh..x: 伦敦一家新创公司给你一份远程合约，薪水用美元付，在拉各斯的家里按英国时间上班。
zh..take.s: 领美元；电力和网络要自己搞定。
zh..take.h: 合约期间薪水大约高80%，但合约很容易结束。工作时间长，健康少一点。

zht..x: 倫敦一家新創公司給你一份遠端合約，薪水用美元付，在拉哥斯的家裡按英國時間上班。
zht..take.s: 領美元；電力和網路要自己搞定。
zht..take.h: 合約期間薪水大約高80%，但合約很容易結束。工作時間長，健康少一點。
